context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “The council binds Jesus; Pilate yields to the multitude” preserves a distinct parallel witness source unit within sentencing.

observations.body: The leaders deliver Jesus to Pilate, accusations and silence follow, Barabbas is released, and Pilate hands Jesus over after flogging him.
observations.label: The council binds Jesus; Pilate yields to the multitude: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, pilate, council visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read Mark 15:1–15 as its own sentencing and mockery crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
